column1: # Per-league Tip 1 hitrate, replayed as-of on the current build over the
# league's most recent fixtures — up to 800, capped at two seasons, which
# is this project's widest validation window. Written by scripts/retrosim.py
# (27 Aug 2026, published says: cup and high-says debits included); read by
# scripts/league_badges.py. At this size the standard error on a row is
# ~1.3-1.5 points; the n=200 table this replaces carried ~2.8 and its worst
# rows were mostly noise (ROU-L1 -11.6 remeasured at -2.8).
